$comment: Single-test exclusions (assurance-lead approved 2026-08-16). File-level quarantine lives in vitest.config.ts exclude + tests/QUARANTINE.md; THIS file is for individual tests inside otherwise-passing files where file-level exclusion would bury valuable coverage. Mechanism: vitest.config.ts builds a negative testNamePattern from these entries (name-based — testNames must remain unique repo-wide). Every entry is mirrored in tests/QUARANTINE.md and ci-evidence.md. No entry without per-test assurance-lead approval.
